sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' lim '||o.limit_price||' fill '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-19 19:40' union all select 'cxl', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,status) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-19 19:40' or cancel_reason in ('pre_event','fill_contagion')) and created_at > '2026-10-15' union all select 'open', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted')
